_comment: KRDict sense alignment for app items (see README.md). Value: a list of '<entry>:<sense>' refs, or "all" (every sense of the one KRDict entry matching word + part of speech). <entry> is the KRDict LexicalEntry id; idiom/proverb entries share their head word's id and are written '<id>/<lemma>'. Items not listed are used only when exactly one entry with one sense matches. Keys starting with '_' are ignored by the build.

_why.v:사정: 事情 only (circumstances + pleading, both on the item); not 査定 'assessment' or 射精
_why.v:모시다: escort/live with/hold a rite; not 'install as head' (4) or 'enshrine' (5)
_why.v:여부: sense 2 (여부가 있겠습니까 'no room for doubt') is not on the item
_why.v:재우다: 'put to sleep' homograph only; the 쌓다/marinate homograph is a side note on the item
_why.v:기르다: not 'train people' (3) or 'let an illness worsen' (7)
_why.v:유치하다: 幼稚 'childish'; not sense 1 'young of age'
_why.x:굴러온-돌이-박힌-돌-뺀다: two spellings of the same proverb
_why.v:쐬다: 'be exposed to wind/sun'; not homograph 'get stung'
_why.v:만만하다: native word 'easy to handle'; not 滿滿하다 'brimming'
_why.v:걸치다:perch: 'rest something across/over'; not the sun-on-ridge sense (1) or 'have a drink' (6)
_why.v:맞추다:adjust: fit a standard / adjust / cater to someone (비위) / be on time
_why.v:어긋나다:contrary: 'fall short of expectations / deviate from a standard'
_why.v:어긋나다:awry: relationship goes wrong + miss each other; sense 2 stays with :contrary so 예의에 어긋나다 never shows here
_why.v:갖추다:equip: have what is needed + meet required procedure/form
_why.v:거치다:process: go through a stage + pass through review/hands
_why.v:대다:cite: give an excuse/reason + name/state a fact (이름을 대다)
_why.v:건지다:salvage: escape with (one's life) + recover/come away with
_why.v:끼다:settle: fog/cloud sets in + dust/grime gathers; homograph 1
_why.v:이루다:form: bring about a state (조화를 이루다) + make up a whole
_why.v:내놓다:release: put a house on the market + release a product
_why.v:돌아보다:reflect: look back (over one's shoulder / on the past / at a situation)
_why.v:내려놓다:let-go: KRDict has only literal 'put down'; it is on the item ('to put down'), figurative uses are not in the dictionary
_why.v:빠지다:absent: left out / missing (6) + skip (8); not 3 'fall short by an amount' (백만 원에서 조금 빠지는 돈)
_why.v:빠지다:fall-into: homograph 2 figurative senses; not literal 'fall into water' (1)
_why.v:빠지다:drain: leak out / stain comes out / strength drains / weight comes off
_why.v:넘어가다:let-slide: move on (to the next item) + let something pass
_why.v:세우다:draw-up: make a plan + set up rules/standards
_why.v:이르다:tell: 이르다² 'tell': tell / admonish / tell in advance / tell on; not 'call X Y' (5) or 'as the proverb says' (6)
_why.v:짓다:conclude: bring to an end (결론/매듭을 짓다); not the literal knot (10)
_why.v:중계되다: broadcast senses; not the neuroscience 'be relayed' (1)
_why.v:발효되다: 發效 'take effect'; not 醱酵 'ferment'
_why.v:수행하다: 遂行 + KRDict files '명령을 수행하다' (carry out orders) under 隨行 sense 2; not 修行 or 'accompany a VIP' (64738:1)
_why.v:습득하다: 習得 'acquire'; not 拾得 'find (lost property)'
_why.v:고인: 故人 'the deceased'; not 古人 'people of old'
_why.v:관용: 寬容; not 官用/慣用
_why.v:꼬박: homograph 1 'a whole (time span)'; not the nodding/dozing mimetic
_why.v:눈살: 'furrow between the brows' (눈살을 찌푸리다); not 눈살 'glare'
_why.v:제재: 制裁; not 題材 'subject matter'
_why.v:인지: 認知; not 人指 'index finger' or 人智
_why.v:경위: 經緯 'how it came about'; not 警衛 (police rank) or 涇渭 'sense of right and wrong'
_why.v:구제: 救濟; not 驅除 'pest control'
_why.v:띠다: bear a mission / take on a color / wear a look / take on a quality; not literal 'tie a sash' or 'carry on one's person'
_why.v:들먹이다: 'bring up, drag in'; the others are physical 'heave up and down'
_why.v:경신: record-breaking; sense 1 'renewal' is the 갱신 meaning the app contrasts it with
_why.v:전가: 轉嫁 'shift blame'; not 傳家 'family heirloom'
_why.v:띄다: 'catch the eye'; not 'ears perk up' (3) or 띄다² 'leave a space'
_why.v:꼬투리: the 꼬투리를 잡다 sense; the literal 'pod' is only a footnote on the item
_why.v:혼동: 'mixing two things up'; sense 2 'fusion' is the 혼돈 neighbourhood the app contrasts
_why.v:들추다: rummage + dig up the past; not literal 'lift up' (1)
_why.v:한참: KRDict lists 한참 only as a noun; same word used adverbially
_why.v:당장: KRDict lists 당장 only as a noun
_why.v:내심: KRDict lists 내심 only as a noun
_why.v:개의치-않다: from 개의하다; examples use 개의치 않다
_why.v:걷잡을-수-없다: from 걷잡다; both senses appear as 걷잡을 수 없다
_why.v:미제-사건: 未濟 'unresolved'; not 美製 'US-made' or 謎題 'riddle'
_why.v:자의적: from 恣意 'arbitrary will'; not 自意 'one's own will'
_why.v:마뜩잖다: from 마뜩하다; its examples are negated (마뜩하지 않다)
_why.x:물꼬를-트다: figurative sense of 물꼬; only sentences containing the idiom are kept
_why.x:선을-긋다: 線 sense 4 ('a set limit'); only sentences containing the idiom are kept
_why.x:핑계-없는-무덤-없다: KRDict spelling 핑계 없는 무덤이 없다
_why.v:지나치다: item covers the adjective (excessive) and the verb (pass by / let slide)
_why.v:십상: KRDict 십상 is "a perfect fit" (바느질이 제일 십상이다); the item is -기 십상이다 "bound to (end badly)", so no sense matches
